title: SunPath Solar Lease Billing Terms
content:
## Section 4 — Billing of the SunPath Solar Lease

**4.1 Start and frequency.** Billing starts the first-bill interval of the system size after the permission-to-operate date, and one monthly lease line is billed for each month of the term.

**4.2 Monthly payment and anniversary escalator.** The monthly payment in the first lease year is the system size's first-year monthly lease payment. On each lease anniversary the monthly payment rises by the system size's annual escalator percent, and the risen payment is rounded half up to the cent.

**4.3 Autopay credit.** When automatic payments are set up, each monthly bill carries a credit of the system size's autopay credit, taken off the monthly lease line. The monthly lease line is then the monthly payment less the autopay credit.

**4.4 Paper bill fee.** When mailed paper bills are chosen, each month carries a paper bill fee line of the paper bill fee.

**4.5 Payments.** Payments are made by an accepted payment method and are applied to the oldest open line.

**4.6 Returned payments.** A returned payment carries the returned payment fee.

**4.7 Figures by size.** For every system size — SunPath 3.2 kW, SunPath 4.0 kW, SunPath 4.8 kW, SunPath 5.6 kW, SunPath 6.4 kW and SunPath 8.0 kW — the monthly lease payment, the annual escalator and the autopay credit used in 4.2 and 4.3 are that size's own figures.

**4.8 Lease balance.** The lease balance is the total of lease payments, fees and buyout amounts billed to the lessee and not yet paid or credited. Each billed line adds to it; each payment received and each credit applied reduces it.

### Monthly bill composition

| Billing preference | Monthly lease line | Paper bill fee line |
|---|---|---|
| Automatic payments set up, paper bills not chosen | Monthly payment less the autopay credit | None |
| Automatic payments set up, paper bills chosen | Monthly payment less the autopay credit | Paper bill fee |
| Automatic payments not set up, paper bills not chosen | Monthly payment | None |
| Automatic payments not set up, paper bills chosen | Monthly payment | Paper bill fee |

### Worked example on hypothetical figures

The figures below are invented to illustrate the arithmetic and are not the figures of any SunPath size: a first-year monthly payment of $101.50, an annual escalator of 3 percent, an autopay credit of $6.00 and a paper bill fee of $2.00, with automatic payments set up and paper bills chosen.

- First lease year: the monthly lease line is $101.50 less $6.00, which is $95.50, and a separate paper bill fee line of $2.00 is billed each month.
- First lease anniversary: $101.50 multiplied by 1.03 is $104.545, which rounded half up to the cent is $104.55. The monthly lease line in the second lease year is $104.55 less $6.00, which is $98.55.
- With an escalator of 0.0 percent the payment would stay at $101.50 after the anniversary.

### Applying a payment — hypothetical

Two lines are open: a monthly lease line billed for an earlier month and one billed for the following month. A payment equal to one line's amount is applied to the line of the earlier month, which is the oldest open line.
